headline: Recommended City Council approve acquisition of 1.44-acre portion of 9 Foss Road for bypass road, 6-0.
summary: The board reviewed plans to acquire 1.44 acres of 9 Foss Road to build a bypass road around the Jordan Road bridge, and voted to recommend the acquisition to City Council. The board also received updates on the Main Street/Sabattus/Canal/Lisbon Street safety study, the Outer Lisbon Street Safety & Mobility Plan, the No Name Pond Overlay ordinance, vacant buildings, and discussed communication between the Planning Board, city staff, and City Council.
decisions: Approved sending a favorable recommendation to the City Council for the city's acquisition of a 1.44-acre portion of 9 Foss Road, 6-0.

decision_evidence.quote: by Lucy Bisson pursuant to Article VII, Section 4(h) of the Zoning and Land Use Code to send a favorable recommendation to the City Council for the acquisition of a 1.44-acre portion of 9 Foss Road. ... VOTED: 6-0 (Passed)
